overview.text: Today's developments highlight significant advances across software verification, agent tooling, and interactive generation models. Claude successfully proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries, discovering long-hidden bugs and demonstrating that formal software verification is becoming feasible at a much larger scale. In streaming video generation, StreamEval addresses the growing need to evaluate interactive models designed for real-time user engagement. Meanwhile, researchers are tackling budget-aware feature adaptation in diffusion models through Policy-Mask, and exploring the limits of frontier coding agents in scientific ML tasks. In the release and open-source ecosystem, new tools like the Zafer-Liu/claude-super-sidebar and hassan-algo/open-sesame introduce enhanced visual interfaces and web-pentest skills for Claude Code, while Anthropic announced the donation of Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation to keep them open and vendor-neutral.

entries.title: LLMs are making formal software verification feasible at a much larger scale
entries.summary: Claude formally proved security properties in the compiled code of 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, it found bugs that had eluded detection for years.
entries.why: Proves security properties across compiled code libraries at scale, finding bugs that previously eluded detection.

entries.title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
entries.summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels.
entries.why: Addresses the challenge of selecting useful intermediate features across trajectories and depths for discriminative tasks.

entries.title: StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
entries.summary: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important.
entries.why: Provides evaluation methods for streaming video generation models designed for real-time user interaction.

entries.title: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
entries.why: Examines shared patterns in how different artificial intelligence models articulate controversial perspectives on humans.

entries.title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
entries.summary: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering.
entries.why: Tests whether frontier coding agents can autonomously climb scientific hills requiring domain-specific insights.

entries.title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
entries.summary: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames.
entries.why: Explores how spatial intelligence systems determine when to use direct observation versus geometric tools.

entries.title: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
entries.summary: Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training.
entries.why: Investigates scene text editing techniques that rely exclusively on real data rather than paired training sets.

entries.title: Zafer-Liu/claude-super-sidebar
entries.summary: A visual sidebar for Claude Code and Codex: agent trees, live status, and conversation task flows. · JavaScript
entries.why: Offers a visual sidebar with agent trees and live status for Claude Code and Codex environments.

entries.title: reacher-z/Awesome-CUA
entries.summary: Open, source-backed catalog of computer-use agents: reviewed papers, GUI models, datasets, benchmarks, tools, and reusable JSONL/SQLite data. · Python
entries.why: Provides an open catalog of computer-use agents, datasets, benchmarks, and reusable data formats.

entries.title: hassan-algo/open-sesame
entries.summary: 🔓 An AI web-pentest skill for Claude Code. Point it at a site you're authorized to test — it maps the attack surface, works through the OWASP WSTG, validates findings, and writes dev + stakeholder reports (PDF). · HTML
entries.why: Implements an automated web-pentest skill for Claude Code to map attack surfaces and validate findings.

entries.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
entries.summary: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
entries.why: Advances vendor-neutral and community-driven safety and research initiatives through open agent skill donations.

entries.title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
entries.summary: Today, we’re inviting members of the life sciences community to apply to work with us on special projects.
entries.why: Invites external life sciences researchers to collaborate on special projects with the lab.

entries.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
entries.summary: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation News today from Anthropic: We’re committed to keeping Agent Skills open, community-driven, and vendor-neutral.
